npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.dating_accep: Well, I'll be! You certainly know how to surprise a person. I was expecting a negotiation, perhaps a trade offer... but this? Hah! I think I'd be a fool to turn you down. Yes, %player%, I'd love to!
You know, I've made plenty of deals in my life, but somehow you've managed to offer me something money can't buy. Hah, that's a rather nice change of pace. Yes, I'd like that!
Well, well... I always knew you had good taste! Though I must admit, I wasn't expecting to be the one on the receiving end of an offer. And yes, I'm accepting!
Oh, that's quite the offer! I'm flattered, truly. But I'm afraid I don't think we're quite the right match. No hard feelings, I hope?
Now, don't get me wrong, I think you're a wonderful person. But I don't believe there's a romantic deal to be made between us.
Hah! You've caught me off guard. Unfortunately, I'm going to have to decline this particular offer. I hope we can still do business as usual!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.default_gift: Oh? For me? Well, that's a pleasant surprise! Thank you, friend. I do appreciate a little generosity now and then.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.dislike.1: Hmm... not exactly what I'd have chosen, but I suppose one shouldn't complain about a free gift. Thanks, friend!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.divorce.1: Well... I suppose this is one deal that didn't turn out quite as expected. I won't pretend I'm happy about it, but I won't hold you back either. Take care, %player%.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.divorce.2: So we're closing this chapter, then? Hah... I suppose not every investment pays off. Still, I'll always value the time we spent together.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.divorce.3: I see. No point trying to sell you on something you've already decided against. I wish you the best, %player%. Truly.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.divorce_erro: Divorce? Hold on! I don't recall signing any marriage contract with you. And trust me, I'd remember a deal that important!
Hah! Trying to cancel a contract that was never signed? I'm a merchant, not a magician! We're not even married!
Now that's a strange request. I'm usually quite good at keeping track of my commitments, and I don't believe we've made that particular one.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.first.1: Well, well! A potential customer! Welcome, friend, welcome! I'm %npc%, and I've got just about anything you could need. Tools, supplies, curiosities, the occasional questionable bargain... Take a look around! I'm sure we can find something that suits your needs. And your wallet, hopefully!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.first.2: Ah, a traveler! Excellent, excellent. The name's %npc%, and trading happens to be my particular talent. Whatever you're looking for, chances are I have it, know someone who has it, or can convince you that you need something else entirely!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.first.3: Greetings! Looking for something special? You've come to the right place. I'm %npc%, purveyor of fine goods, useful trinkets, and deals that are almost too good to be true. Almost, mind you!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.first.4: Oh, hello there! Don't be shy, have a look around. Everything's for sale, and I'm always open to negotiations. Well... within reason. A merchant has to eat, after all!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.follow_no.1: Ah, what a shame! I've got a few things to take care of anyway. Can't let the business run itself, unfortunately.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.follow_no.2: Not today, friend. I've got some rather important matters to attend to. Very profitable matters, I hope!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.follow_no.3: Tempting, but I'll pass. Someone has to stay here and keep the local economy alive!
Back already? Well, that was a worthwhile trip. Do let me know if you find anything interesting. I might be willing to make an offer!
Hah! Good journey, good company. Now, back to business. Those coins aren't going to collect themselves!
Well, it's been fun! Try not to spend all your money before visiting my shop again.
Keep an eye out, %player%. You never know when something valuable might be lying around. And if you find anything shiny, do remember your good friend %npc%!
Quite the scenery, isn't it? I wonder if there's anyone around who might be interested in a little trade...
I hope this journey proves profitable. Not necessarily in gold, of course. Information can be just as valuable!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.follow_yes.1: An adventure? Why not! Might stumble across something worth a fortune. Or at least something worth selling!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.follow_yes.2: Absolutely! A change of scenery does wonders for the spirit. And who knows, perhaps I'll find a few new customers along the way!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.follow_yes.3: Hah! You drive a hard bargain, but you've convinced me. Let's see what fortune has in store for us!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.greeting.1: Ah, %player%! My favorite customer! Well, one of my favorites. Don't tell the others. Found anything valuable on your travels lately?
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.greeting.2: There you are! I was beginning to think you'd found another merchant. Don't tell me you've been cheating on my business!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.greeting.3: Good day, good day! How's business? Mine's excellent, naturally. Though it could always be better...
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.greeting.4: Well, if it isn't my favorite adventurer! Come to spend some money? No? Well, we can work on that!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.hate.1: Good heavens! I've seen some questionable merchandise in my time, but this... Hah, I suppose even a seasoned merchant can't recognize value in everything.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.like.1: Now that's what I call a fine choice! You've got an eye for quality, %player%. I might have to hire you as my personal buyer!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.marriage_acc: Marriage? Now that's a long-term investment! Hah! But in all seriousness, I can't think of anyone I'd rather share my fortunes and misfortunes with. Yes, %player%! Let's make it official!
Well, I've spent my life collecting all sorts of valuables, but I think I've finally found something worth more than all of them combined. Yes, I'll marry you!
A lifetime together, you say? Hah! I suppose that's the one deal I'm willing to make without reading the fine print. Of course I'll marry you!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.marriage_den: Now hold on, that's a rather serious proposition. I don't make lifelong commitments without thinking them through. Give me a little time, alright?
Marriage? Hah! That's a bigger investment than anything I've ever considered. I care about you, but I'm not quite ready to take that step.
Oh, you've certainly given me something to think about. But I don't want to rush into a decision like this. Let's take our time, shall we?
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.procreation_: Hah! Even the best investments need time to mature. Let's not rush things, shall we?
Patience, friend! Not every worthwhile venture needs to happen immediately. How about we enjoy a little time together first?
Let's take a little break, shall we? Even I know when it's time to stop chasing opportunities and enjoy what I've already got.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.talk.1: People always say money can't buy happiness. Nonsense! It can buy a comfortable bed, a warm meal, and someone else's problems. That's close enough for me.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.talk.2: The secret to good trading? Never let the other person know how much you actually want something. Unless, of course, you're the one selling it. Then act like it's the rarest treasure in the kingdom!
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.talk.3: I've traveled to quite a few places in my time. You'd be surprised what people are willing to trade. One fellow once exchanged an entire wagon of apples for a slightly rusty helmet. Still don't know who got the better deal.
npc.runecraftory.merchant.1.talk.4: A good merchant needs three things: a sharp eye, a sharper tongue, and the patience to deal with people who insist on haggling over every last coin. Hah! You wouldn't believe some of the arguments I've had.
